entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿĀtika bint Khālid al-Khuzāʿīyya nicknamed Umm Maʿbad was a woman from the Khuza'ah tribe who lived during the time of the Islamic prophet, Muhammad and provided a physical description of him.
